title: Vetting Process for Potential Grassroots Leaders, Key Appointment Holders and Patrons for Susceptibility to Foreign Influence
what_it_is: Vetting Process for Potential Grassroots Leaders, Key Appointment Holders and Patrons for Susceptibility to Foreign Influence

sections.label: GRL appointment and conduct
sections.summary: GRLs must conduct themselves befittingly and act in Singapore's interests, with due diligence in appointments and action if unsuitable.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: As leaders in the community, GRLs are expected to conduct themselves in a manner that befits their standing and role in the community, and also to act in Singapore's interests.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: There are sound processes and due diligence in place when appointing and re-appointing GRLs, regardless of their background, to ensure that they are able to carry out the above duties.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: We constantly review the appointment system to ensure that there is sufficient rigour.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: For instance, before GRLs join GROs and are appointed to leadership positions, they first serve as observers for a period of time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: This is an opportunity for them to be given direct and hands-on exposure to grassroots work, but also an opportunity for PA to observe them and assess their suitability for appointment into GROs as full-fledged GRLs.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: But even the most rigorous checks cannot preclude the possibility of the person subsequently behaving in an unbefitting manner or discovering a hitherto unknown fact or circumstance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Culture, Community and Youth (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai)
sentences.text: Where such facts are brought to PA's attention, we will take immediate action to reassess the person's suitability to continue as a GRL and revoke the GRL appointment if necessary.

sections.label: GRL advice on influence
sections.summary: The system is reviewed periodically to check for avenues or agencies GRLs can seek advice from when facing influence attempts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Second, I want to check whether there are avenues or agencies that GRLs can seek advice, in the event that they are approached by individuals or organisations or encounter situations where there may be attempts at influence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: We look at it periodically to assess whether or not the system that we have in place remains rigorous, given the evolving circumstances on the ground.

sections.label: PRs as GRLs
sections.summary: A proportion of PRs take up leadership positions as GRLs, but not foreigners.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: A proportion of the PRs do take up leadership positions as GRLs, but not foreigners.
